LanguageData.EMPExplodeDesc: An electro-magnetic pulse set inside the base has gone off and overloaded the power generators, causing them to break down.
LanguageData.MessageCommandoAssaulting: Seeing that the EMP has gone off from afar, ratkin forces waiting nearby join the assault.
LanguageData.RatHoleGone: The rat hole has been destroyed.
LanguageData.BlockChanceDefualtDesc:
Deflection
The chance to block damage from outside.

Only frontal attacks can be blocked; the allowed arc differs by shield. Check this item's "shield deflect angle" stat.
This chance is based on wearer's Melee skill and armor rate of this equipment.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Injured_DescShort: At least {0} injured folk in the settlement.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Priest_Injured_Desc1: Are there any here in need of a healing hand?
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Priest_Injured_Desc2: With faith, even hardship may yet be overcome.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Priest_Medicine_Desc1: It would ease my heart to see ample remedies here.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Priest_Medicine_Desc2: With enough medicine, I could tend to many more souls...
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_StableLife_DescShort: Settlement wealth must be at least {0}.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_StableLife_Desc1: I long to dwell in a proper village. The wanderer's road is too cruel.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_StableLife_Desc2: I seek a steadier village life. Small hamlets ask too much of a soul.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_NewLife_DescShort: Settlement wealth must be at least {0}.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_NewLife_Desc1: With means such as these, perhaps I could begin anew.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_NewLife_Desc2: I have had my fill of a poor life.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_NobleTired_Desc1: I am weary of bowing and scraping before the highborn.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_NobleTired_Desc2: I want no more dealings with nobles.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_ServantRoyalTitle_DescShort: Highest Empire title among settlers must be {0} or lower.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_ServantRoyalTitle_Desc1: I am weary of currying favor with the highborn.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_ServantRoyalTitle_Desc2: If I must serve, I shall choose my own master.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_WindFreedom_Desc1: Life on the road has its charms, yet a spell of rest does too.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_WindFreedom_Desc2: Even a wanderer has tastes. I would need gear worth using.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_SeekingMentor_DescShort: Need a settler with all of these skills: {0}
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_SeekingMentor_Desc1: I heed only one stronger than myself.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_SeekingMentor_Desc2: I seek a true warrior. Is there one among you?
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Prepared_DescShort: Need a settler with at least one of these skills: {0}
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Prepared_Desc1: I am tired of surviving by my wits alone. I seek a proper mentor.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_Prepared_Desc2: Be it battle or craft, someone here must truly know their trade.
LanguageData.RK_JoinReq_JoinHope_Desc2: I hope we shall get along well.
LanguageData.RK_ShieldFaceDirectionDesc: Click a point to face that direction. Hold position while facing. Target a pawn to track them continuously.
LanguageData.RK_ShieldFaceDirection_InvalidState: Cannot use while dead or downed.

LanguageData.AbilityPrayerServiceDisabledPulpitForbid: The pulpit is forbidden to this pawn.
LanguageData.AbilityPrayerServiceDisabledPulpitDanger: The pulpit area is too dangerous.
LanguageData.AbilityPrayerServiceDisabledRoomTooSmall: Worship space is too small (room must be larger than 25 cells).

LanguageData.RK_AllowedGripType_Report: Weapon grip types that can be wielded as primary weapon together with this equipment.
LanguageData.RK_WanderingCaravan_ArrivalLetter: A wandering ratkin caravan is approaching. Talk to the leader to initiate trade or recruit new settlers.
LanguageData.RK_WanderingCaravan_AlreadySpawned: The caravan is already on the map. Dismiss the current caravan if you want to spawn another one.
LanguageData.RK_WanderingCaravan_AttackedPenalty: The caravan is trying to leave after being attacked.
LanguageData.RK_BFR_Ammo_DescToHE: Switch to airburst rounds. The rounds currently loaded can punch through several targets in a line with strong piercing damage and defeat armor.
LanguageData.RK_BFR_Ammo_DescToAP: Switch to armor-piercing rounds. The rounds currently used can detonate mid-air when it gets close to its target, dispersing shrapnel in front and shredding tight groups of enemies.
LanguageData.RK_PulseRifleFireMode_DescToSingle: Switch to sniper mode. Currently fires four lighter bolts in quick succession at shorter effective range, suited to close and mid-range fights.
LanguageData.RK_PulseRifleFireMode_DescToBurst: Switch to rapid fire mode. Currently fires two heavy energy bolts while offering longer range and better accuracy for medium and long range combat.
